title: Intransigent Warhammer

sources.title: Impulse Blast
markers: | description = Knocks nearby creatures {{Cond|Prone}} after killing a target or landing a [[Critical Hit]].

summary: This warhammer creates a shockwave when it kills an enemy or lands a critical hit.

fields.Impulse Blast: A kill or critical hit with this weapon triggers a shockwave. Nearby enemies make a hidden DC 14 Dexterity save or fall Prone for 2 turns. The pinned source gives no exact radius.
fields.Acquisition: Found in a watertight chest on the duergar skiff during the first trip to Grymforge.
fields.Base value: 100 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
